items.headline: Winklevoss Files Spot $ZEC ETF With 0.25% Fee
items.summary: Winklevoss Asset Services filed for a spot $ZEC ETF under ticker WINK, with Gemini as custodian, rivaling Grayscale's ZCSH as privacy coins stay hot.

items.headline: Ether.fi Taps $ENA for New Dollar Stablecoin
items.summary: Ether.fi is launching a dollar stablecoin powered by Ethena, which will manage reserves, minting and compliance for a platform with $300M+ in stablecoin balances.

items.headline: Polymarket V2 Goes Live With pUSD Collateral
items.summary: Polymarket rolled out Protocol V2, replacing its legacy Gnosis setup with a single ERC-1155 positions contract and pUSD collateral.

items.headline: $ARB DAO Eyes 100M Token Boost for USDG Push
items.summary: Arbitrum adopted Paxos' USDG as its ecosystem dollar, live with Fluid, Morpho and GMX, while a proposal asks the DAO to add 100M $ARB in incentives.

items.headline: $APT Unveils MonoMove, 55x Faster Market Engine
items.summary: Aptos launched MonoMove, a new engine claiming 55x faster performance for onchain markets, aiming to supercharge its DeFi ecosystem.
